answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit copper bond on one pulse station in the atlas. Each epoch the atlas opens a 90-second window for one fresh signed pulse. Atlas timestamps let auditors replay each pulse; a missed window, reused pulse, or shared station burns the copper bond. Each fake costs 35+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,532,500 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-pulse rings show shared timestamps. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps its bond.
